CAVNAR AI — LOGO & IDENTITY

The Seal: a square ring, flat-cut like a branding iron, with one live ember banked in the gap. The wordmark is drawn geometry, not a font — and it hides the same ember in the V.

One rule everywhere: paper and ink, plus a single point of ember. No appetite-orange lowercase (the restaurant-tech uniform), no purple gradient or sparkle (the AI uniform).

Boards 01–04: the system. Boards 05–08: the campaign — stationery, welcome kit, web, out-of-home.

The typography-only answer: CAVNAR stands alone. Custom stencil-cut caps, one 15° lean shared by every diagonal, the A·V pair kerned into a constant 12-unit channel, and the ember living in the V's negative space — the name carries its own symbol.
